Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: photorealistic lighting-comparison concept visual.
Input image 1 is the edit target and the only spatial reference. Edit this exact photo, changing ONLY lighting and time of day.
Lock the camera position, lens, perspective, 3:2 framing, room size and every architectural edge. Preserve ALL geometry and every object exactly: burgundy leather sofa and its seams/wrinkles/cushions/throw, round smoke-glass coffee table and curved metal base, neutral patterned rug, dark wood wall panels and wood grain, TV and cabinet, vases and branches, books/bowls, dining table/chairs, shelving, art, door, glass partition, ceiling drum light, dining pendant, spot fixtures and cabinet table lamp. Do not add, remove, reshape or move anything. Preserve the original furniture layout and room identity.
Clean high quality photorealistic interior photograph, tactile realistic material detail, coherent light transport with source-dependent highlights, reflections, falloff, occlusion and contact shadows. Do actual relighting, not an overall color filter. No graphic overlay, labels, text, watermark, collage or border.
Output one landscape PNG at native 1536x1024 pixels with the exact original uncropped composition.
Lighting change: bright neutral diffuse daytime from the real window direction off-camera at left/front, with credible soft window-cast illumination crossing the room and floor. Use neutral natural daylight and legible wood/leather detail. ALL artificial lights are OFF: the ceiling drum shade, dining pendant, cabinet table lamp, every recessed spot, and every cove are unlit, with no emissive glow or pools of electric light. The unlit shades read as solid ivory materials receiving daylight; bulbs and downlight lenses do not glow. Cove channels are unlit architectural recesses. This is bright window-lit daytime, not a dark lights-off room and not a warm sunlight filter.
